notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
Small fixes, including:

- Fixed issue with being able to pick up the same object again by clicking too fast
- Fixed issue with not being able to throw spear after having a throw interrupted by an enemy
- Changed to three clock drawings on the clock puzzle door

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Now with difficulty modes!
notes.content:
- Added new Easy and Hard modes (you can change difficulties at any time during the game, though you'll have to save and reload for it to take effect)
- Medkit heals more health in Easy and Normal difficulties
- Damage dealt by player and enemies scale according to difficulty

notes.title: Achievements have been added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42751589/7e41b0cc6a9dda41b730fcf18c5b31f47666e6e9.png[/img]

Observo's achievements have now been set up and are fully functional!

Currently, the game has 17 achievements you can unlock, with the possibility of more being added later. They range from things you'll automatically get as you progress through the story to the ones that are locked behind specific requirements. Some of the images above are from hidden achievements, I just won't say what they represent, hehe...

Next up is getting cloud saves to work, and a closed beta through Steam will also begin very soon!

- SpaceZeta
